title: Swiss {ai} Weeks 2026
blurb: Nationwide umbrella series of AI hackathons and executive dinners running through early October.

title: ETH AI Center Researchers Community Meetup
blurb: Recurring meetup series for the AI research community at ETH Zurich.

title: Hack am Rhein 2026
blurb: Four-day interdisciplinary hackathon for the Basel region with challenges from pharma, high-tech manufacturing, architecture and social impact, closing with Sunday demos on the FHNW campus.

title: Hack Apertus
blurb: Two-week online hackathon building on Switzerland's open Apertus LLM, with red-teaming and Swiss-language localisation tracks; on-site legs follow in six Swiss cities through to the May 2027 finals.

title: Azure Zurich AI Agents Governance Night
blurb: In-person Azure user-group evening on running AI agents securely: agent identity in Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC and policies across Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry, plus enterprise agent governance.

title: Forum EPFL 2026
blurb: Switzerland's largest tech recruitment fair, with 188+ companies exhibiting at EPFL.

title: Networking: Trust by Design – Standards for Aligned AI Governance
blurb: Standards-focused networking event on aligned AI governance and the EU AI Act.

title: Webinaire : Baromètre IA relation client 2026 en Suisse
blurb: French-language webinar presenting the first Swiss survey of how AI is actually used in customer relations — which use cases are live today, what is holding adoption back, and what Swiss companies can take from the findings.

title: Dell Technologies Forum Zürich 2026
blurb: Full-day German-language conference for Swiss IT leaders on future-ready AI and infrastructure, drawing 700+ attendees across intelligent endpoints, modern infrastructure and AI skills.

title: Panoramai Summit Geneva 2026 – IA et nous, responsables
blurb: Full-day summit on responsible AI and governance, free in the morning.

title: SC70: Cybersécurité pragmatique & UX à l'ère des LLM
venue: Digicomp Academy Suisse Romande, Av. de la Gare 50
blurb: Two French-language talks in Lausanne: turning a technical vulnerability report into a strategic decision tool, and four paradigms — Vanilla, MCP, MCP Apps and WebMCP — for designing interfaces in the LLM era.

title: Votation 2032
blurb: A French-language role-play of a 2032 Geneva cantonal voting campaign, using generative AI to produce the campaign material — a hands-on look at what shifts in public debate when convincing content costs almost nothing but verification still does not.

title: AI Office Hours – Vol. 1
blurb: No slides and no fixed agenda — an open Zurich session where the room sets the topics, bringing whatever AI tools, questions and stuck problems they are actually working on.

title: Alpine Agentic Search
blurb: Four technical talks on how retrieval, vector search, reranking and generative models are changing for agent-driven workloads, including evaluation for multi-turn search agents, aimed at senior ML and infrastructure engineers.

title: Salon RH 2026
blurb: HR and recruitment trade fair with a growing AI-in-hiring track.

title: Zürich — 87th Fabric User Group
blurb: The Swiss Fabric user group’s monthly online session: Kristian’s "What’s New" round-up of the platform, then Zebra BI as guest on their Zebra AI solution. Recorded and published afterwards.

title: Advanced LLM Applications and Agentic Systems — Training at EPFL
cost: CHF 1,000 (10% off for EPFL alumni and SDSC partners)
blurb: One-day hands-on SDSC training on structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling and agentic workflows — and the evaluation and cost control needed to run them in production.

title: {Tech: Europe} Agentic AI Hack Zurich
blurb: A one-day agentic AI hackathon capped at 70 builders — teams form in the morning, mentors and free compute credits on hand through the day, live demos at 20:00 and awards at 20:45.

title: Build Your Own Assistant: Stop Drowning In Your Inbox
blurb: Three hours of hands-on building in Geneva: wire an agent into your inbox, calendar and Slack so it sorts what is urgent and drafts the replies.

title: Coffee & Prompt #006
blurb: Relaxed weekend-morning coworking in Geneva for builders, makers and the AI-curious — work on your own project, optionally show what you have made, and get feedback from the room.

title: Fabric Governance — Domains, Workspaces & Lineage
organiser: Data and AI for Intelligent Cloud
blurb: Zurich Microsoft data-platform group on governance patterns that scale rather than block: workspace design, domains and decentralised ownership, capacity planning, and lineage for compliance.

title: OWASP Switzerland — 25th Anniversary Edition
venue: ETH Zurich, Zurich Information Security and Privacy Center, FoodLab, Universitätstrasse 6
blurb: Anniversary edition with three talks — making AI a strategic partner in security (SIX), where well-meant phishing advice backfires (ETH Zurich), and using OWASP as one prioritisation lens from APIs through to agents (Microsoft) — then an apéro riche.

title: AWS Swiss User Group Geneva #29 — Digital Sovereignty in the Cloud
venue: AWS Geneva Office, Place de Hollande 2
blurb: Autumn meetup of the Geneva AWS user group, taking on digital sovereignty in the cloud — what it means for where data sits and who controls it.

title: Client Zero — Agentic AI in Action
venue: IBM, Salle Centerstage, Esplanade de Pont-Rouge 9A
blurb: IBM applies its own "client zero" rule — run it on yourself first: two talks on a real HR and IT transformation where agents handle transfers and password resets, and on the architecture underneath it, followed by Q&A and networking.

title: IBM Bob Coding Watch Party Zürich
blurb: Hands-on hybrid session at IBM’s Zurich office on IBM Bob, an AI development assistant for building and modernising code, with beginner, intermediate and expert tracks.

title: ERH Physical AI Hackathon
blurb: Around 50 European engineers get 36 hours with robot arms, mobile platforms, sensors and compute on the DARE Campus, with on-site mentors and a closing pitch to founders, researchers and investors.

title: Neural Wave 2026
venue: Università della Svizzera italiana, Aula Magna, Via Giuseppe Buffi 11
organiser: Neural Wave / Università della Svizzera italiana
blurb: Second edition of the student-run 48-hour AI hackathon at USI Lugano, where teams from Switzerland and abroad take on real problems submitted by partner companies using machine learning and data science.

title: Smart Services Summit 2026
blurb: Summit on AI-enabled services and data-driven value, hosted by the Swiss data innovation community.

title: Build Your Own Assistant: Widen Your Reach
blurb: Build an agent that scans your industry and city for events worth your time and tells you why to go and who to meet, instead of trawling listings by hand.

title: People Analytics Switzerland Meetup | October 2026
blurb: Autumn session of the Swiss people-analytics community, sharing practice and fresh thinking on AI and analytics initiatives inside Swiss organisations. Places are tightly limited.

title: Same, But Better. No Mistakes. An Introduction to Agentic Legacy Modernization
blurb: Michael walks through an agent-ready approach to legacy modernisation — which established principles carry over to agentic software engineering, and what is still missing before a modernisation effort actually succeeds.

title: Ethische Führung im KI-Zeitalter: Wie gelingt verantwortungsvolle Innovation?
blurb: German-language keynote by Sebastian Rosengrün on the social dynamics of AI, then a panel with Christian Hugo Hoffmann and practitioners on what responsible AI leadership actually requires, followed by an apéro.

title: Google AI Live + Labs — Zurich
blurb: A day of Google Cloud keynotes and hands-on labs on putting AI agents into production, with four tracks to choose from: automating business processes, the technical foundations for scaling agents, a developer lab and a lab on grounding agents in your own data.

title: Microcity AI Matchmaking
blurb: Thirteen AI startups pitch solutions across automation, data optimisation, knowledge management and industrial operations, after which companies take up to six five-minute one-to-one meetings matched to the problems they actually have.

title: Mindstone Geneva October AI Meetup
venue: L'Annexe by Rentes Genevoises, Rue du Port 3
blurb: Monthly Geneva AI evening with three talks — lessons from building with LLMs, getting more done with AI tools, and where AI takes work and daily life next — followed by pizza, drinks and networking.

title: Our Minds Under Siege — An Evening with Bruno Giussani
venue: ETH AI Center, OAT S 15, Oerlikon
blurb: An evening on AI, information and trust: how machine-generated content is changing our ability to tell truth from manipulation, and what it takes to keep human judgement intact in a world shaped by algorithms.

title: F{AI}R Unconference 2026
blurb: Two days of AI talks, workshops and demos in Bern run as an unconference, with the programme built from sessions submitted by the people who turn up.

title: The Zurich AI Summit 2026 – Digital Trust
blurb: An evening for around 250 Swiss AI and business leaders, built around a panel on digital trust with speakers from Novartis, ABB, Nemetschek Group and Swiss Re, followed by networking.

title: Zurich Robotics Roundtable #5
blurb: Zurich’s quarterly gathering for people building in robotics and physical AI — newly funded robotics startups present, then a panel and open networking for around 250 founders, engineers and researchers.

title: AI Productivity User Group Conference @ Microsoft Switzerland
blurb: In-person conference on AI productivity tooling — Copilot Cowork, Azure AI integration, and AI-driven meeting workflows — with MVP speakers at Microsoft's Zurich Airport campus.

title: ArtTech Hack 2026
blurb: A three-day hackathon in Zurich for students and recent graduates from art, design and technology, with briefs in data, simulation and robotics — challenges revealed Friday, building Saturday, jury presentations Sunday.

title: Zentral Hack 2026
blurb: 24-hour hackathon for central Switzerland, bringing together students, business and the regional ICT community at HSLU Rotkreuz.

title: Build Your Own Assistant: Never Walk Into A Meeting Blind
blurb: Build an agent that briefs you on the person, the company and the purpose before every meeting, then drafts the follow-up the moment it ends.

title: AI in azienda: Dal prompt al processo

blurb: Second of three Italian-language evenings on using AI deliberately in a business: turning individual tool use into organisational value, with a Use Case Canvas worked through on the spot. Thirty places, priority to local SMEs.

title: Leading Data Conference Switzerland 2026
cost: 200 CHF (170 early bird) / 140 CHF members (110 early bird)
blurb: DAMA Switzerland's annual data leadership conference at IMD Lausanne, covering data modelling, data-as-an-asset workshops, and CDMP certification.

title: Swiss Data Space Forum 2026: Unlocking Data for AI
blurb: National forum on data governance and data spaces for AI, hosted at unlimitrust.

title: CAR16 : IA en entreprise avec AI Foundry et sécurité des MCP
venue: Tesla Store Genève, Rue de la Confédération 8
blurb: French-language Azure community evening in Geneva on enterprise AI with Azure AI Foundry, securing Model Context Protocol servers, and modern cloud architecture and automation with GitHub Copilot.

title: Conversation avec Bruno Giussani sur l'emprise et la souveraineté technologique

blurb: A French-language discussion with Swiss author and podcaster Bruno Giussani on resisting technological capture and European dependence on American digital infrastructure, drawing on his Manuel de résistance à l'emprise technologique.

title: Fabric & Power BI User Group Geneva 2026
blurb: Geneva user-group evening on Power BI and Microsoft Fabric — speaker sessions, customer use cases and product news, followed by an apéro.

title: The Great Data Heist: Trust, Power & Cyber Warfare

title: Spec-driven Development mit KI

blurb: Two German-language talks on the OST Rapperswil campus: Java Champion Simon Martinelli on driving development from specifications with AI, and Michael Inden on why algorithms and data structures matter more, not less, once everyone can generate code — followed by networking.

title: AI Breakfast #55 Luzern
blurb: Next instalment of the Lucerne breakfast series on AI in business; topic to be announced.

title: BaselHack 2026
blurb: Free 48-hour hackathon for the Basel region with open and sponsored challenges, for developers, designers and anyone wanting to turn an idea into a working prototype.

title: Build Your Own Assistant: What Did I Even Get Done This Week?

title: Snowflake Forum Zurich 2026

blurb: Free data-platform conference bringing together Swiss data teams and partners.

title: Swiss AI Safety Days 2026

title: Build Your Own Assistant: Time to Stop AI Slop

title: UNIGE – Recherche documentaire et IA

blurb: A full day of keynotes and workshops for food-industry professionals past the AI hype stage, on what it actually takes to implement AI against real problems inside their own organisations.

blurb: A full day on how Switzerland builds strategic independence in AI between US and Chinese dominance — lessons from other middle powers, Swiss research including the Apertus foundation model, industry deployment realities, and concrete recommendations for national strategy.

title: Navigating Data Protection and Transfer Impact Assessments for AI Startups
blurb: Breakfast session with lawyers from Wenger Vieli on when a Transfer Impact Assessment is actually required for cross-border data transfers, and how to keep them manageable as an AI company.

title: DevOps for Fabric — Git & Deployment Pipelines

title: AI Startup Center Community Meetup — November Edition

title: Swiss AI Summit 2026
blurb: Full-day summit on enterprise AI strategy with executive roundtables.

blurb: Closing evening of the Ticino series on conscious AI use in business, this one on data, responsibility, rules and governance — content, a hands-on workshop and networking, capped at thirty participants.

title: AI Breakfast #56 Luzern
blurb: November edition of the Lucerne breakfast series on AI in business; topic to be announced.

title: The Geneva AI Conference 2026
blurb: Evening conference on enterprise AI strategy and ROI with an IBM/SAP panel.

blurb: The on-site leg of the national Apertus hackathon: build on the open Apertus 8B model, strengthen its multilingual abilities and ship applications for private- and public-sector problems, with everything released as Open Commons.

blurb: Executive workshop for CEOs, CFOs, CDOs and CTOs on turning data and AI into measurable business value, with case studies from EKZ, Merck and Richemont. Limited seats.

title: Databricks Data + AI World Tour Zurich 2026
blurb: Databricks' flagship Swiss event on the Lakehouse platform and Unity Catalog.

title: IBM Bob Coding Watch Party Zürich — Final Edition

title: Fabric Year in Review 2026 — Highlights & Outlook

blurb: Year-end session from the Zurich Microsoft data-platform group on what actually shipped in Fabric during 2026 and what is worth planning for next.

title: The Night of Data Talents: Swiss Edition
blurb: Swiss data startups pitch to an investor panel with community voting, capping the year for the Suisse Romande data scene.

title: Generative AI & Agentische Systeme

blurb: Two-day German-language course for developers, architects, data scientists and ML engineers on building agentic LLM systems that survive production: function calling, hybrid-search RAG, LangGraph topologies, security hardening and systematic evaluation. Places are limited.
